answer: Quadratic levy on correlated keys. Step 1, a name joins only at a capital inlet, posting a 1,600 POA yield-free anchor locked 22 epochs; the inlet logs its funding path. Step 2, each epoch a tracer follows the settlement river and groups keys that share a payer or mixer hop. Step 3, copied work or a missed freshness check burns every anchor, bills 80 × n² POA, and exiles all 18 epochs. One honest name locks 1,600 POA; 1,000 clones fed by one river owe 80 million POA plus 1.6 million idle, against a ~180 POA take. Split-later wallets are the hole; reconvergence is billed from first contact.
